proposition: Iskandar b. ʿUmar Shaykh was Ibn Turka's patron in Shiraz and Isfahan before Shāhrukh's western campaign of 817/1414: MK reads letter 8 as addressed to Iskandar (presumably) and letters 12 and 16 treat Iskandar as patron; in letter 8 Ibn Turka regrets being unable to call in person and writes to state his regard.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Iskandar b. ʿUmar Shaykh (addressee presumed)
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: Addressee of letter 8 is MK's presumption ('?' in his heading)
